method: Wash and dry the lettuce and tomato. Shred the lettuce and slice the tomato; put both on a clean plate, separate from the raw filling.
Warm the wholemeal flatbread in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 30–60 seconds on each side, until flexible. Keep it covered on a clean plate.
Mix the measured light mayonnaise and wholegrain mustard in a clean small bowl. Keep this finishing sauce separate from the uncooked filling and refrigerated until assembly.
Drain the firm tofu, pat it dry and cut it into 2cm cubes. Coat with all the measured black pepper. Use clean utensils for the cooked tofu.

Heat the measured olive oil in the non-stick frying pan. Cook the tofu cubes over a medium-high heat for about 8–10 minutes, turning so several faces become golden and the centre is hot. Follow any longer cooking instruction on the tofu pack.
Put the lettuce and tomato on the warm flatbread. Add the browned tofu cubes and the cold finishing sauce, fold the bread around the filling and serve immediately.
